how_to_test: Measure with Layout Inspector / Accessibility Scanner
pass_criteria: All tappable elements at least 48x48 dp

how_to_test: Open Training Video Hub on a 5-inch 720p phone
pass_criteria: Primary action visible without scrolling (sticky bottom bar)

how_to_test: Count words above the action; read with a non-literate tester
pass_criteria: Short sentences; icons or audio for key info; no 3-paragraph blocks

how_to_test: Accessibility Scanner + test outdoors at noon at 50% brightness
pass_criteria: Text contrast at least 4.5:1 (7:1 preferred); no light-grey text

how_to_test: Turn on TalkBack / tap play-audio icon
pass_criteria: Description available as audio in local language

how_to_test: Play 3-4 videos back to back on 4GB RAM device
pass_criteria: No ANR; memory returns to baseline; low-res option available
Downloaded video plays; clear message and icon if not downloaded
No clipped or overlapping text; buttons still visible
Labels fit; no truncation; correct script rendering

how_to_test: Show screen to field workers without explanation
pass_criteria: Icons understood; colour never the only signal (add icon + text)
Clear visual sign the module is complete

how_to_test: Interrupt video with a call / low battery

pass_criteria: Video + controls + Next fit sensibly; no horizontal scroll
Warning before large download; resume support
